prompt: Photorealistic product rendering, true side view of a stair-climbing parcel trolley on residential stairs with load present. A tall twin-tube aluminium trolley leans slightly back on stair nosings, pulled by a courier's hands on a closed-loop handle at top. At the base, a triangular tri-star cluster on each side with three small solid-rubber wheels, one wheel bearing on the stair nosing edge, mid-rotation over the step. Twin parallel spine tubes run from the axle up to the handles. A steel brake band wraps the star carrier with a small pawl engaging it, cable running up the spine to a deadman lever under the handles. A flat aluminium toe plate juts forward at the base carrying a large taped cardboard parcel about knee-high, secured by two fabric harness straps with buckle over the top. Mid-spine shows a chunky fold hinge with lock plates and small lock window. In soft background, a thin folded-flat trolley slab leans against the stair wall to show stow shape. Real materials: brushed aluminium, black rubber tyres, steel hardware, brown cardboard, dark webbing. Soft daylight with product-shot fill, sharp focus on mechanism, stairs and wall simple light tone for contrast. Show fixed spine and toe versus rotating star wheels and moving brake lever. Add clean legible callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines to each part: Tri Star Wheels, Twin Spine Tubes, Brake Band Pawl, Toe Plate, Loop Handles, Fold Hinge Lock, Harness Strap, and no other text.
must_not: diagram color fills and solid circles

visual_plan.view: side view, unfolded working view with folded slab context
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Side elevation, slightly angled for depth. Foreground: three stair treads rising right to left. Trolley diagonal across steps, toe and parcel forward over lower tread, star clusters on nosing, spine rising to upper left, handles at hip-to-chest height with hands. Folded flat slab propped against wall in blurred background lower left. Empty sky/wall space around for callout tags.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Mid-climb heave: trolley leaned back, tri-star mid-rotation with one small wheel on the nosing edge and another lifting to next tread, parcel strapped on toe, courier pulling loop handles, brake pawl holding carrier to prevent runaway.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Load path toe plate into twin spine tubes into tri-star carrier into stair nosing; control path deadman lever via cable to brake band and pawl on carrier; lock state path hinge pin position to visual lock window.
visual_plan.interactions: Toe plate bolted to lower spine carries parcel weight up into tubes; tubes bolt to tri-star axle; brake band wraps star carrier and pawl drops into carrier teeth, released by cable from deadman lever on handles; harness straps clamp parcel down to toe and spine; mid-spine hinge joins upper and lower tubes and locks with pin.

focus_parts.material: solid rubber tyres on steel hubs
focus_parts.purpose: walk over stair nosings with one wheel always bearing
carry parcel load in bending to axle

focus_parts.material: steel band and pawl with cable
focus_parts.purpose: hold on nosing fail-safe when lever released
one-person lever heave at hip height
fold flat for stow and lock rigid unfolded
